question: Are the subtle channels operative in the going and coming of this realization?
premises: Ida, pingala, and shanta are named.
Their existence in going and coming is negated.
This realization does not depend on them.
inference: In this realization, ida, pingala, and shanta are not operative in going and coming.
uncertainties: gamāgame may refer to breath movement or to cyclical existence.
plain_english: There is no ida, pingala, or shanta in the going and coming.
